risks.title: Intense competition in robotic-assisted surgery market
risks.score_rationale: Lead risk in 10-K Risk Factors section. Strong language: 'could result in reduced revenue and loss of customers'. Competitors include established players (Johnson & Johnson, Medtronic) and emerging startups. Competition intensifying globally, particularly in China. Critical strategic threat to ISRG's market dominance.
risks.summary: Growing competition from established medical device giants and emerging startups threatens ISRG's dominant position in the robotic-assisted surgery market.
_validation: Verified from 10-K Risk Factors: 'OUR COMMERCIAL LANDSCAPE IS HIGHLY COMPETITIVE, AND CUSTOMERS MAY CHOOSE OUR COMPETITORS PRODUCTS OR SERVICES OR MAY NOT ACCEPT ROBOTIC-ASSISTED MEDICAL PROCEDURES, WHICH COULD RESULT IN REDUCED REVENUE AND LOSS OF CUSTOMERS'

risks.title: Impact of weight loss medications on bariatric surgery demand
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned with concrete 2023 example: 'in 2023, certain drugs initially approved for use in diabetes patients gained acceptance for use in weight loss treatment following FDA approvals for weight loss'. Direct impact on procedure volumes. Represents structural market shift away from surgical interventions.
risks.summary: Rising adoption of pharmaceutical weight loss treatments reduces demand for bariatric surgery, directly impacting da Vinci system utilization and sales.
_validation: Verified from 10-K Risk Factors: 'in 2023, certain drugs initially approved for use in diabetes patients gained acceptance for use in weight loss treatment following FDA approvals for weight loss'

risks.title: US-China trade and geopolitical tensions
risks.score_rationale: Multiple operational impacts documented in 10-K. Tariff framework implemented 2025 with baseline rates plus country-specific rates for China, Mexico, Germany. Company manufactures instruments in Mexico (USMCA-qualified), endoscopes in Germany, imports raw materials from China, operates local manufacturing in China. Reciprocal tariffs announced by other jurisdictions amplify exposure.
risks.summary: US-China trade tensions, tariff implementation beginning 2025, and geopolitical uncertainty create supply chain risks and cost pressures across ISRG's manufacturing and distribution operations.
_validation: Verified from 10-K MD&A Trade and Tariffs Update section: 'Beginning in 2025, the U.S. implemented a baseline tariff framework on most imports with higher country- and product-specific rates for certain trading partners, including Mexico, Germany, and China'
Verified manufacturing locations: Mexico (instruments, accessories), Germany (endoscopes), China (raw materials, sub-assemblies, local Xi manufacturing)
Confirmed USMCA qualification for Mexico-manufactured products
Confirmed reciprocal tariffs from other jurisdictions
